admissions.reason: Candidate R2 describes a specific genetic disorder, Frontotemporal dementia and parkinsonism-17, linked to a TBK1 gene variant. This is distinct from the other candidates which describe broader neurological syndromes without this specific genetic etiology.

Candidate R3, Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, focuses on motor neuron disease symptoms like tongue atrophy and specific EMG findings, which are distinct from the primary features of the other candidates.

Candidate R1, Progressive supranuclear palsy, is characterized by vertical gaze palsy and basal ganglia dopamine transporter loss, which are distinct from the genetic and motor neuron-focused aspects of the other candidates.

completions.completed_label: Frontotemporal dementia and parkinsonism-17 due to TBK1 gene variant
completions.reason: The TBK1 gene variant is the specific etiology for this type of frontotemporal dementia and parkinsonism.
support_spans: Heterozygous pathogenic variant of TBK1 gene (p.E643del) identified by whole-exon sequencing
